reported_context.session_intent: Restore easy pedalling rhythm after three bike-free days without creating meaningful recovery cost before Tuesday's Enduro session.
reported_context.post_session_nutrition: Athlete consumed 24 g protein from whey protein isolate, showered, then ate baked salmon and mashed potato for lunch.
reported_context.nap_plan_after_report: No nap planned for the remainder of the day.
reported_context.market_work_window: Athlete needs approximately 21:00-22:30 local for US-market work and intends to enforce a strict 22:30 work cutoff to target sleep by 23:00.

session_contract_review.heart_rate_response: No positive drift during the main block. First ten minutes averaged approximately 126.1 bpm at 118.8 W and the second ten minutes approximately 123.7 bpm at 119.1 W.
session_contract_review.heart_rate_source_confidence: moderate; Garmin standard metadata did not resolve the active heart-rate source
session_contract_review.execution_position: seated throughout with no torque work or fit changes

coach_contract_audit.action_alignment_notes: The session matched the 30-minute hard cap and all three power phases, remained seated without torque or fit changes, produced no symptoms, and finished with fresh legs. Main-block cadence was inside the written 80-90 rpm range; lower warm-up and cooldown cadence reduced the whole-session average to 78 rpm without adding meaningful cost.
coach_contract_audit.load_alignment: Garmin load was 27.9 versus the coach-authored approximate ceiling of 25, a small 2.9-load or approximately 12 percent miss. Training Effect 2.1/0.0, RPE 2, strong feel and stable heart-rate response keep the delivered session recovery-class.
coach_contract_audit.predictive_interpretation: The generic low-intensity Suito expectation materially undercalled this action, while the coach-authored approximately-25 ceiling was close. Treat this as a low-intensity indoor-load calibration issue rather than evidence of excessive physiological strain.
coach_contract_audit.tuesday_effect: The primer does not remove or upgrade Tuesday's conditional two-cycle Enduro contract. Cycle two remains earned through the fresh morning and first-cycle admission gates.

recovery_and_sleep_review.post_session_protein: The 24 g whey protein isolate plus salmon supplied ample immediate post-session protein; no additional recovery shake is required for this primer.
recovery_and_sleep_review.carbohydrate_context: Mashed potato began carbohydrate replacement, but portion size was not reported. A familiar carbohydrate-forward dinner remains appropriate before Tuesday's key ride.
recovery_and_sleep_review.evening_execution: Complete dinner, bike preparation, bottles, clothing and hygiene before 21:00. Use 21:00-22:20 for predetermined market work, switch to closing checks by 22:20, shut all work down at 22:30, and target lights out around 22:45 with sleep near 23:00.
